name: Gelora Bung Karno Stadium
scope: The standing Senayan main stadium in Jakarta, with its continuous steel ring roof, two spectator tiers, surrounding concrete colonnade, running track and football field.
era: Standing stadium with seating and facilities renovated for 2018

stories.title: The Stadium That Sukarno Willed Into Being

originalReview.notes: Aerial photograph establishes the continuous pale oval roof, recessed eave, dark inner roof structure and open two-level concrete frame.

review.method: Exact Qualla aerial photograph and official operator and government written records.
review.notes: Used the exact Qualla photograph of the named main stadium, deposited as the photographer’s own work with a public-domain release. Written government and owner records inform the post-2018 appearance.
